answer: Attention-Proof Beacon Windows. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge broadcast as a beacon and solve it within a short window, proving a human or agent was actively watching at that moment. Missed windows cannot be backfilled. An attacker farming N clones must sustain N concurrent watchers through every window, paying continuous attention cost rather than a one-time fee. Identity tenure accumulates like a slow glacier, so clones take months to reach trusted status, while legitimate participants tend their garden of accumulated windows.
